candidates.change_summary: Delete the line `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` so the recipient's reward balance is never zeroed when a withdrawal is made.
Delete the `require(success);` statement so the function completes (zeroing the reward and decrementing state) even when the external call fails.
Replace `_nonReentrant` with no modifier on withdrawReward so the lock state is never set or toggled by calls to withdrawReward.
Change `_locked = false;` to `_locked = true;` so the reentrancy lock stays engaged after withdrawReward completes.
Delete the statement `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` so the bonus can be claimed multiple times for the same recipient.
Delete the statement `rewardsForA[recipient] += 100;` so no bonus reward is credited and withdrawReward sends 0 value.
